functions.name: referee_v5_current_user_has_assignment
functions.searchPath: public as $$ select exists ( select 1 from public.referee_assignments ra where ra.tenant_id = p_tenant_id and ra.tournament_id = p_tournament_id and ra.match_id = p_match_id and ra.referee_user_id = auth.uid() and ra.status = 'active' and ra.role = any (p_roles) and (ra.token_expires_at is null or ra.token_expires_at > now()) and (ra.revoked_at is null) )

functions.name: referee_v5_is_super_admin
